runs.content: Nasdaq, Inc. closed at a 52-week high after a strong Q3 (revenue +13%, non-GAAP EPS +18%, Index +39%) with a lowered opex guide and steady buybacks; FTNT was stopped out at $139.10 (−18.10%) the same day.

S&P Global beat Q3 and raised FY26 adj EPS, revenue and margin guidance, yet was flat on the print and sits 12.5% below its 52-week high, with >$7B of buybacks and a Capital IQ strategic review as added catalysts (ELV trimmed −4.54% for capacity).
